verdict.rationale: Vanta's own TPRM product discovers vendors, which builds an inventory, runs assessments, and monitors third-party risk. It also pulls security-posture findings from vendors' SOC 2 reports, DPAs and questionnaires, so the core of the story is first-party. However, per-vendor data-access tracking and a configurable vendor review cadence are not explicitly documented; 'monitors third-party risk' only implies ongoing review. Missing for 10: explicit vendor data-access classification, documented recurring vendor review scheduling/reminders, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the TPRM workflow.

support.subject: As an operations lead, third-party vendors are inventoried and risk-reviewed in the platform — security posture, data access, review cadence — instead of a spreadsheet

citations.quote: Vanta's TPRM Agent automatically discovers vendors, accelerates assessments, and monitors third-party risk.
Vanta automatically pulls findings from your vendors SOC2 reports, DPAs, and questionnaires so your team focuses on high-stakes decisions, not paperwork.
